Family Law Attorneys in Lakewood, CO

Support When Family Challenges Feel Unmanageable

When relationships shift or break down, it affects every part of your life. Whether you’re facing a divorce, raising children in two homes, or trying to protect your financial future, it can feel like everything is moving too fast. At The Drake Law Firm, we help Lakewood families take control of what comes next.

Our attorneys bring steady, strategic support to tough situations, so you can make decisions with clarity instead of fear. We handle complex issues with care and keep the focus where it belongs: your future, your children, your peace of mind.

Talk to a Lakewood Family Attorney Today

Protecting What Matters in Lakewood, CO

Family issues don’t come with easy answers. That’s why we work closely with every client to understand their circumstances and help them move forward. From parenting plans to spousal support and property division, our firm handles a full range of family law matters across Lakewood:

Divorce and Separation Parenting Time and Custody Child Support and Alimony
We guide you through filing, negotiations, and preparation—so every step supports your goals, whether your divorce is straightforward, contested, or somewhere in between.

How We Help Families in Lakewood

No two families are the same. That’s why we adapt our legal strategies to fit your priorities—whether that’s protecting your children, avoiding a drawn-out court battle, or preserving your finances. Here’s how we support people throughout Lakewood:

Direct, Honest Communication Local Insight That Helps
We speak clearly, set realistic expectations, and don’t stir up conflict just to look tough. You’ll always know where things stand and why. We know how Jefferson County District courts work, what judges expect, and how to keep things moving when delays or missteps could cost you.
Consistent, Steady Support Calm in Hard Moments
We stay responsive and focused throughout your case. Whether it’s a quick question or a major decision, we show up when it counts. Emotions run high in family cases. We bring clarity and direction, especially when you’re too overwhelmed to figure out what to do next.

Talk to a Lakewood Family Lawyer Who Gets It

If your family situation is changing, now is the time to understand your legal options. Speak with a Lakewood family lawyer who will listen, explain your rights, and help you take the next step.

Schedule Your Consultation Now

What Working With a Lakewood Family Law Attorney Looks Like

1. Schedule a Consultation 2. Create a Plan Around You 3. Move Forward With Support
We’ll listen to your story and identify what issues you’re facing—divorce, custody, financial concerns, or all three. You’ll leave with a clearer sense of what’s next. Every case needs a different approach. We build your legal plan around your values, your goals, and the practical realities of your life in Lakewood. We’ll help you take strategy action, negotiating where possible, standing firm when needed, and staying available as questions come up along the way.

Your Family Deserves a Fresh Start

You don’t need to be sure of everything right now. Let us help you regain stability, protect what matters most, and make decisions that feel right for you.

Talk to a Lakewood CO Family Law Attorney Today

Lakewood Family Law Attorney FAQs

What does a Lakewood family law attorney do?

A Lakewood family law attorney helps clients resolve legal matters that affect their families, such as divorce, custody, parenting plans, child support, and property division. At The Drake Law Firm, we work closely with Lakewood clients to understand their goals and take practical steps that protect their future. Whether you’re filing for divorce or modifying custody, a family lawyer helps you understand your rights, complete paperwork, and reach workable agreements.

Do I have to go to court for a family law case in Lakewood?

No, not every family law case in Lakewood has to go to court in person, although most new cases require a virtual court appearance called an Initial Status Conference. Many issues, like child custody,  support, or separation terms—can be settled through negotiation or mediation. If both parties are willing to cooperate, your Lakewood family lawyer can help draft legally binding agreements without having to visit a courtroom. But if cooperation breaks down, your attorney is prepared to represent you at hearings to resolve the remaining disputes.

How long does it take to get divorced in Colorado?

Colorado has a mandatory 91-day waiting period before a divorce can be finalized. This clock starts once your spouse has been served, or immediately if you filed together. After that, the timeline depends on how quickly you and your spouse agree on key issues like custody, support, and property division. A Lakewood family lawyer can help move things forward efficiently and make sure everything is handled correctly from the start.

What happens if we already agree on everything?

If both spouses agree on all terms, like parenting time, asset division, and support—you can submit your documents and your settlement for the court to approve.  This is called an uncontested divorce. Uncontested divorces are usually faster and more affordable than a fight. Your Lakewood CO family law attorney will still review your mandatory financial disclosures, your parenting plan, and the agreement on assets and debts to protect your interests, make sure everything complies with Colorado law, and file the necessary documents so the court can finalize the divorce without delay.

Can I change my custody or support order later?

Yes, custody and child support orders can be modified if your circumstances change. This might include a job loss, relocation, changes in parenting time, or shifts in a child’s needs. To request a change, you must show that the new situation is significant and affects the original order. A Lakewood family lawyer can help you prepare the request, file it with the court, and advocate for terms that reflect your current reality.
